id./param/scenario/cs/a_130_cs_010.pack|cs_: "Outta the way, drongos! Some of us've got sights to see!
"I see this place is still full of friendly visitors...
"We passed through a while back on the hunt for clues about Mordegon, ye see.
"'The beatific smile of the mural of the ruins of Nhou Wat brings good fortune to all who lay eyes upon her.'
"Well, if they believe that kind of rubbish, I'm guessing you didn't find out much of use...
"Hyeh heh heh! Aye, laddie, not a sausage! But we're looking for something different now.
"And we've the Luminary with us too. It might be worth another look at those ruins with fresh eyes.
"We'll have to go through town and over the mountain to get there. Let's split up and see what we can find out.
